checks.detail: Expected guard and authoritative discovered population both equal seven.
Seven ordered Dynamics feature IDs are unique and no foreign feature package is declared.
Each package declares and contains README.md, manifest.json, contract.json, acceptance.json, and traceability.json; examples are honestly omitted.
Every feature has an authoritative mathematical contract, source prototype IR, test plan, finalized IR, algorithm specification, and acceptance oracle.
All eight traceability categories are non-empty and significant source multiplicity is preserved.
Every manifest and contract declares the same eight existing shared contracts; the domain catalog union matches.
All seven strategy contracts are partially constrained; algorithm step lists were not copied as mandatory total orders.
Only immutability, non-visible input changes, and no observable partial result are prescribed; other low-level choices remain implementation-defined or unconstrained.
Authoritative lower-case error meanings are represented by exact uppercase schema-compatible identifiers and documented as a local transport representation decision.
Acceptance test identifiers are globally unique across the Dynamics population and use schema-valid categories.
Only Dynamics feature packages, the Dynamics domain catalog, and Dynamics handoff reports were modified.
No unresolved scientific question was answered; all execution semantics remain structural-only, preserved unresolved, or external-provider-required.

The unchanged validator accepts feature_count or population_count, while the protected Dynamics inventory declares authoritative_population_count. CI evidence is required; neither protected file may be changed in this task.
